headline: Micronesia, Fed. Sts.: +2.1% growth in 2025, 2.8% inflation, debt 9% of GDP
sections: Micronesia, Fed. Sts. is a $507 million economy (2025), the world's 210th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +2.1% in 2025, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $4,604 at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 0.5% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 2.8% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 5.0% in 2022.
Gross government debt is 9% of GDP (2025), a low level that has fallen from 20% in 2020. The general government balance is +0.4% of GDP (2025), a surplus.
The current account balance is +3.7% of GDP (2025). Trade equals 93% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy.
IMF projections put government debt at 9% of GDP by 2031, broadly stable from today's level. Life expectancy is 67.4 years (2024). Population: 76 thousand (2025).
